blocks.title: jenna kutcher says her DMs made her *$1.4 million*

blocks.caption: her words, on her own blog. let's break it down.

blocks.lead: "Chat funnels have generated $1.4 million in revenue for my business."

blocks.text:
a chat funnel is simple: people comment a word, and they get a DM with the thing they wanted.

she also says over 52,000 new emails came from them, in a single year.

on september 10, she posted "Comment BIOHACK".

it got **9,456 comments**, when her usual post gets about 54.

on one launch, 85% of the people who commented gave their email in the DMs.

no landing page, just a conversation in the DMs.
the DM is where you **shake it**.
an automation sends the link. then people start replying.

chat.text: can i ask you something real quick?

blocks.text: at 9,456 comments, someone has to answer all of that. it's not a funnel anymore, it's a full-time job.

list: pick one word per offer, and put it in your bio too.
send the free thing first, then ask one question.
answer every reply within the hour, so the conversation never goes cold.
